::: {#sol-bec-capacity}

1. Given $X = x$, the output is $x$ with
   [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1 - \alpha$
   and $\mathrm{e}$ with probability $\alpha$,
   so $\entropyf{Y \mid X = x} = h(\alpha)$ for both values of $x$,
   and averaging over $x$ gives $\entropyf{Y \mid X} = h(\alpha)$.

2. The chain rule gives

   $$\entropyf{Y} + \entropyf{E \mid Y} = \entropyf{Y, E} = \entropyf{E} + \entropyf{Y \mid E}.$$

   Each value $y$ of $Y$ fixes $E$,
   so $\entropyf{E \mid Y = y} = 0$ for every $y$, and $\entropyf{E \mid Y} = 0$.
   Hence $\entropyf{Y} = \entropyf{E} + \entropyf{Y \mid E}$.

3. The channel erases with probability $\alpha$ whatever the [input](#def-channel),
   so $E$ is [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) of $X$ and $\entropyf{E} = h(\alpha)$.
   Given $E = 1$, $Y = \mathrm{e}$ for certain, so $\entropyf{Y \mid E = 1} = 0$.
   Given $E = 0$, $Y = X$, and since $E$ is independent of $X$,
   $\P(Y = 1 \mid E = 0) = \P(X = 1) = \pi$,
   so $\entropyf{Y \mid E = 0} = h(\pi)$.
   Therefore

   $$
   \begin{aligned}
   \entropyf{Y}
   &= \entropyf{E} + \P(E = 1) \, \entropyf{Y \mid E = 1} + \P(E = 0) \, \entropyf{Y \mid E = 0} \\
   &= h(\alpha) + \alpha \cdot 0 + (1 - \alpha) \, h(\pi) \\
   &= h(\alpha) + (1 - \alpha) \, h(\pi).
   \end{aligned}
   $$

4. Combining parts 1 and 3,

   $$
   \begin{aligned}
   \mutinfof{X}{Y}
   &= \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X} \\
   &= h(\alpha) + (1 - \alpha) \, h(\pi) - h(\alpha) \\
   &= (1 - \alpha) \, h(\pi).
   \end{aligned}
   $$

   Since $h(\pi) \le 1$, with equality at $\pi = 1/2$,
   the [maximum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-maximum) over input [probability mass functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pmf) is $C = 1 - \alpha$.
   The receiver loses a share $\alpha$ of the [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit)
   and learns the rest exactly;
   @cover2006elements [section 7.1] reach the same [capacity](channel-capacity.qmd#def-channel-capacity).

:::
